content: Tauri v2 Wayland/NVIDIA: DMABUF renderer causes blank windows. Fix: set env vars before webview init: __NV_DISABLE_EXPLICIT_SYNC=1 (try first), WEBKIT_DISABLE_DMABUF_RENDERER=1, last resort WEBKIT_DISABLE_COMPOSITING_MODE=1. Window focus bug on v2 (issue #10746). Broken scrolling on Wayland (issue #14427). Clipboard unavailable case not handled gracefully. Set env vars in main() before tauri::Builder.
